name: Build CSS
instruction: Write CSS classes for every element in the component. Every property value comes from the deep extraction + token mapping. No values from memory. No 'looks about right.' If a value was not extracted, go back and extract it.

process.instruction: Write the section's root class with exact extracted values: display, flex-direction, padding (all four sides individually if they differ), gap, background, position, width constraints.
process.verify: Does this class contain every non-default property from the section frame's extracted styles?

process.instruction: Write classes for each direct child of the section. Include layout properties (flex, grid, gap, alignment), sizing (width, height, flex-grow, flex-shrink), and visual properties (background, border, shadow, radius).
process.verify: For each child class, compare its properties against the extracted styles for that node. Are any missing?

process.instruction: Continue writing classes for every level of the tree. Do not stop at 'the card component' - write classes for the card header, the icon container inside the header, the label text, and the body text. Every node in the catalog that has non-default styles gets a class.
critical_properties_often_missed: gap - the space between sibling elements. This is THE most missed property and causes the biggest visual deviations.
padding vs margin - Paper uses padding. Record whether spacing is on the container (padding) or the child (margin).
flex-shrink: 0 - on elements with fixed width inside flex containers. Missing this causes unexpected compression.
line-height - Paper specifies exact px line-height. Using unitless or em line-height produces different spacing.
letter-spacing - especially on headings. -0.02em vs 0 is visible.
maxWidth - on text blocks. Missing this lets text span the full container width.
position: absolute + top/left - for overlapping or offset elements. Missing this collapses them into flow.

overflow: clip on sections with absolute children - if a section has overflow: clip and absolute-positioned children that extend past the section's in-flow height, they get clipped. Either remove overflow: clip or increase padding-bottom to accommodate the absolute overflow. Calculate: abs_child.top + abs_child.height - container.height = overflow amount. Add that to padding-bottom.

fill images (logos, avatars, photos) - Paper nodes with backgroundImage: url(...) are actual images. Extract them with get_fill_image, download to the project's static asset directory, and render as tags. Empty placeholder divs are a defect.

font-family mismatch between contexts - a Paper file may use one family for page chrome and another for product UI (popovers, cards, labels). Check which context each element belongs to and use the matching {font} token, not the first family you saw.

floating callout badges - glass-effect badges that annotate a dashboard. These are ALWAYS position: absolute with specific coordinates from Paper. Rendering them in flow breaks the layout. Extract their exact top/left/bottom/right from get_computed_styles.

process.instruction: For every bleed_node and offset_node flagged in the inventory, implement the offset + clip pattern. This is the most commonly missed layout behavior because it is invisible in flat style extraction - it only shows up when comparing child positions against parent boundaries.

pattern.offset_child: margin-left: var({prefix}pad-section) shifts the element rightward from the normal content flow. Use width: 100% so the element's right edge extends past the container.
pattern.container_clip: The nearest wrapping container (inner wrapper, not the section itself) needs overflow: hidden to crop the overflow. If the section itself clips, the background or padding area may be affected.
pattern.section_clip: The section frame also needs overflow: clip as a safety net.

process.common_mistake: Setting overflow: clip only on the outermost section but not on the intermediate wrapper that actually constrains width. The overflow escapes through the wrapper and produces a horizontal scrollbar or content spilling past the viewport edge.

process.instruction: After writing all CSS, walk the node catalog one final time. For each node, verify: does it have a CSS class? Does that class contain every extracted property? Log any gaps and fix them.
process.method: Create a mental checklist: catalog node ID -> class name -> property count from extraction vs property count in CSS. If CSS has fewer properties, something was dropped.

responsive_handling.instruction: Paper designs are fixed-width. Add responsive breakpoints at 1100px and 767px that gracefully degrade the layout. Key adjustments:

changes: Section inline padding reduces to var({prefix}pad-section)
Multi-column layouts collapse to single column
All multi-column grids become single column

reduced_motion.instruction: Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) that disables transforms on hover, makes transitions instant, and stops any animations. This is an AC requirement, not optional.
